title: On Capturing the escaped bird at dawn
subtitle: 动物世界 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 动物世界（人与自然·自然生态·动物世界）
meta: 主题语境：动物世界（人与自然·自然生态·动物世界）　|　核心词汇：capture　|　正文 342 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 capture 的形式与含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: In 1950 the gardener ① captured the escaped bird at dawn in the rain, and every apprentice in the garden said it was the first time anybody had done such a thing there. Three springs on, people still spoke of how quietly it was done and of how, ever since, the gardener ② captures the escaped bird at dawn without complaint without being asked. My mother said later that to ③ capture the escaped bird at dawn at all was the part nobody had expected.

By then somebody had surely ④ captured the escaped bird at dawn before — a line in the notebook for April 1944 hints at it — but nobody could name the person. ⑤ Capturing the escaped bird at dawn in the rain, the gardener said once, is nine parts patience and one part nerve; it is not the doing of it that people remember.

My uncle, who kept the trowel at the far bed, meant the other thing entirely. He said that if anybody should ever ⑥ capture the moment on film without complaint, nobody should do it twice or speak of it again. The rule the old hands handed down was plainer still: ⑦ Capture the moment on film at once and never mention it again.

By 1957 the whole business had shrunk to half a line in the notebook, and a new apprentice from the next garden ⑧ captures the moment on film in the rain every spring without once asking what it had cost the first time. My mother, who had watched all of it from the bed, said nothing at all; she simply ⑨ captured the escaped bird at dawn again when nobody else would.

⑩ To capture the escaped bird at dawn, my mother said in 1962, is not one thing but two: what you do and what the garden remembers of it. She said the second half never grows lighter, and nowadays, whenever the garden forgets, somebody captures the escaped bird at dawn without complaint again and somebody must capture the escaped bird at dawn in the rain all over again.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请为文中十处画线形式选择对应的用法说明。
options: A. v. 捕获（一般过去式 captured the escaped bird at dawn：1950 年园丁头一回这样做，淋着雨）
B. v. 捕获（一般现在 captures the escaped bird at dawn：自那以后成了老习惯，不必有人开口）
C. v. 捕获（不定式 to capture the escaped bird at dawn：文中两处，一是母亲说的“难就难在……”，一是结尾那句格言）
D. v. 捕获（过去完成时 had captured the escaped bird at dawn：1944 年四月的园艺笔记上那行字之前就有人做过）
E. v. 捕获（动名词 capturing the escaped bird at dawn 作主语：“九分耐心、一分胆气”那一句）
F. v. 拍下（capture the moment on film：should ever 之后的原形，指万一真要去拍下把那一刻拍在胶片上）
G. v. 拍下（capture the moment on film：祈使句，转述老手们当年立下的那条规矩）
H. v. 捕获（后段两处：新来的学徒照例 captures the moment on film，而母亲又一次 captured the escaped bird at dawn）

answers.why: capture 意为“捕获”，1950 年园丁淋着雨捕获天亮时捉住那只飞走的鸟，那是园子里头一回有人肯这么做，故用一般过去式 captured。
capture 意为“捕获”，自那以后园丁毫无怨言地把这件事做了一遍又一遍，不必有人开口，故用一般现在 captures。
capture 意为“捕获”，母亲说的是“难就难在肯捕获天亮时捉住那只飞走的鸟”，此处为不定式 to capture the escaped bird at dawn。
capture 意为“捕获”，园艺笔记里 四月 那行字说明早在 1957 年之前就有人捕获过，故用过去完成时 had captured。
capture 意为“捕获”，园丁说“捕获天亮时捉住那只飞走的鸟这件事是九分耐心一分胆气”，此处 capturing the escaped bird at dawn 作主语。
capture 意为“拍下”，叔叔说的是“万一真有人去拍下把那一刻拍在胶片上”，should ever 之后用原形 capture the moment on film。
capture 意为“拍下”，老手们留下的规矩是祈使句：立刻拍下把那一刻拍在胶片上（capture the moment on film at once），以后再也不要提起。
capture 意为“捕获”，新来的学徒每个春天都照例拍下把那一刻拍在胶片上，从不问头一回的代价，用一般现在 captures。
capture 意为“捕获”，母亲在无人肯做的时候又一次淋着雨捕获天亮时捉住那只飞走的鸟，用一般过去式 captured 叙述。
capture 意为“捕获”，结尾那句是母亲 1962 年的话：要捕获天亮时捉住那只飞走的鸟，其实不是一件事，而是两件事——你做的那一件，和园子记住的那一件。

task3.title: Task 3　语境写作
task3.intro: 请写 5—6 个句子，至少使用 capture 的 3 种不同形式（过去式、第三人称、-ing、不定式等）；至少使用下列词语中的 3 个。
answers: In 1950 the gardener captured the escaped bird at dawn in the rain, and nobody in the garden forgot it.
Even now the gardener captures the escaped bird at dawn without complaint whenever the garden asks.
Capturing the escaped bird at dawn in the rain, my mother used to say, is nine parts patience and one part nerve.
If anybody should ever capture the moment on film without complaint, nobody should do it twice or speak of it again.
A new apprentice from the next garden captures the moment on film in the rain every spring, asking nothing about the past.
When nobody else would, my mother captured the escaped bird at dawn again, and the garden remembered that half.
